text:
Maria Lopez: quick question — I need to give the infra oncall team read-only access to production logs for a 48h investigation, but absolutely no PII exposure. What is the least-privileged way to do this that we can grant quickly?

Devon Chen: short answer: don't add project-wide viewer. Create a logs-specific binding and use a group or short-lived SA. Prefer condition on the binding to restrict logName or resource labels.

Samir Patel: +1 to group + short-lived SA. Proposal: create group infra-logs@redwood.com, grant roles/logging.viewer with a condition limiting to the app logs only. Example gcloud add-iam with condition: ```bash
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member='group:infra-logs@redwood.com' \
  --role='roles/logging.viewer' \
  --condition="expression=resource.labels.log_name.startsWith('redwood-app'),title=infra_logs,description='app logs only'"
```
(ops: exact condition syntax may need tweaking for GCP variant)

Jordan Park: are the app logs redacted already? If not, we should avoid giving anyone access until we strip PII at ingestion or use a redaction view.

security-bot: Note: current log pipeline performs structured-field redaction for fields tagged as pii_*; unstructured messages may still contain PII. Check the observability sink config: projects/redwood-prod/sinks/app-sink -> has filter `labels.service="redwood-app"` and transform step for pii_json_fields.

Kelly Nguyen: For a fast short-term path: create a service account infra-logs-sa@redwood-prod. Give it roles/logging.privateLogViewer (if available) scoped to the app logs with condition. Then allow infra to impersonate the SA for 48h via IAM approval ticket. Example token generation: ```bash
gcloud auth print-access-token --impersonate-service-account=infra-logs-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com```

Devon Chen: alternative: use Access Context Manager / short-lived access via our JIT system. We can add the group to the JIT policy and set 48h default. That avoids permanent bindings.

Maria Lopez: sounds good. Action items I hear: (1) Kelly to create infra-logs group + SA, (2) Samir to draft IAM condition and PR, (3) Jordan to confirm redaction coverage and list remaining fields. I'll open a short access ticket for 48h approval.

Kelly Nguyen: working on group + SA now. Will post the exact binding command and expiry ETA here when done. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: I'll drop a sample condition in the PR — leaning to expression that matches resource.labels.k8s_app=="redwood-app" and logName startsWith. Keep it narrow.

Jordan Park: FYI observability team flagged two message templates that still include user_email — I'll add a remediation note. We should not grant access until that's scrubbed or until we scope to a log view that excludes message text.

Maria Lopez: thanks everyone. If we can't get scrubbing by EOD, we'll proceed with SA impersonation + ticket and record all access to an auditable log.

security-bot: Reminder: any role granting read access to logs must be recorded in the security access registry per policy SEC-45. Please link the ticket ID when you create the binding.
